name: Fujiwara no Teika
source:
Hobby: Pursuing the Ultimate Beauty

Known as "the Apostle of Beauty," he has a very high standard of beauty. His level of Waka, which he started learning at childhood, is even high enough for writing an anthology.

[Edited from [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/miyabi.html]English official site[/url]]
